summary: Updated every surface that described the leaves as having no scheduled renewer or as renewed by the --check-only drift cycle: the internal_tls, proxmox_host, openbao, microk8s and ssh_host_cert role READMEs, the playbook catalogue, the OpenBao and ssh-host-cert-expiry runbooks, step-ca-bootstrap's two unworkable 'run the drift cycle' instructions, support/iac-agent's job inventory, the slice-testing-strategy serial check, and three bullets in AnsibleSpecs decisions.md (:65, :256, :458 — :26 and :294 were already settled by P4). kc project lint and kc project test both green; committed as 658a341 (Ansible, phase/016-docs) and d736f98 (AnsibleSpecs, main), nothing pushed. No architecture-model nudge: no new host, daemon or external identity, and the model names none of these Jenkins jobs. Close-out carries the doc phase's Summary and Focus lines, B10 (no X.509 counterpart to ssh-host-cert-expiry.md — not written because whether internal_tls re-issues an already-expired leaf could not be grounded from the repo), S5, and notes on B2/B4.
